Subject: Re: Healthlytix MSA redlines — proposed operational handback

Following our 1:30 sync — notes and operational asks for the redline response: 

1) SOC 2 artifacts we can provide:
- Full SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) with customer-specific SOC carveouts redacted.
- Management's assertion letter and control mapping (CSV).
- System architecture diagram (redacted).

2) Pen test cadence:
- Offer: annual scheduled external pen test (customer notified 30 days prior) + one optional scheduled test per year on request (so 2/year max) OR emergency test with 48–72 hr notice for verified security incidents.
- Scope: application layer + infra boundary documented in the exhibit; infra-level exploit proof-of-concept limited to non-production staging unless explicit orderform includes production testing and signed risk waiver.

3) Inspection windows:
- Propose sample-based evidence deliveries every quarter (artifact bundle) instead of full privileged inspection. Quarterly bundles include: authentication logs for sampled dates, change-control audit trail extract (last 90 days), and a summary of incident response drills.
- If Healthlytix insists on interactive access, we will provide a 4-hour remote session (screen-sharing) with redwood engineers and a mutually-agreed scope; on-site/privileged SSH access is not acceptable without a separate SOW and insurance certificates.

4) Evidence handling and retention:
- Evidence bundles will have sensitive fields redacted; we will provide hashing/attestation to show completeness.

Action items:
- Logan: incorporate the above into a short exhibit counterproposal (one page) for Healthlytix.
- Karthik: legal to convert operational commitments into tight contract language and propose fallback language if Healthlytix requests broader rights.
- Priyom: prep the HS procurement contact and include evidence expectations in the mutual action plan.

— Neha

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Healthlytix MSA redlines — draft clause suggestions

Thanks — concise and very helpful. Draft language suggestions below (high level; I'll produce redline in track changes after you confirm approach):

A) Audit rights (narrowed):
"Customer may request audit evidence relating to the Services limited to: (i) the most recent SOC 2 Type II report and associated management assertion; (ii) evidence bundles and logs as described in the Security Exhibit (quarterly sample bundles); and (iii) a mutually-agreed external penetration test not to exceed two scheduled tests in any 12-month period, plus testing reasonably required following a documented security incident. All audits shall be conducted on reasonable notice and during Redwood's normal business hours unless otherwise agreed in writing."

B) Privileged access carveout:
"Except as expressly set forth in an agreed Order Form or SOW, Customer shall not be entitled to privileged access (SSH, console, or administrative credentials) to Redwood environments. Interactive remote sessions may be scheduled up to one business day in duration for the purposes of reviewing artifacts with Redwood's engineering personnel. Any privileged or on-site access required by Customer shall be subject to a separate SOW, insurance requirements, and appropriate security controls."

C) Evidence redaction and attestation:
"Redwood may redact customer-identifiable data and other sensitive operational details from provided artifacts. Redwood will provide cryptographic hashes or attestations sufficient to demonstrate the integrity and completeness of redacted artifacts."

Notes/asks for external reply: please confirm whether Healthlytix requires production-level pen testing in-scope (they indicated possible infra testing). If so, we need either (1) SOW + insurance, or (2) limit to staged environment.

I'll draft tracked redlines and a clean exhibit for review by EOD tomorrow.

— Karthik

Next steps: Priyom — can you send the mutual action plan (dates + owner for SOW, SOC2 delivery, pen-test window) and Karthik — we will review the draft redline when you have it.
